adaptation.objective: MSE(mean over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity), no auxiliary losses
adaptation.diagnostic_small_configuration: Only explicitly selected server scientific tests may use reduced widths/depths. Such tests do not admit the full profile or silently replace it.

adaptation.permissions: Existing six-axis IMU and train average-velocity labels only. Reference orientation is the admitted task-view rotation, not a separate model input. No runtime calibration/scaling statistics, pose, image, text, initial velocity, extra sensor or test-driven choice.
adaptation.loss_identity_policy: set_loss rejects all non-MSE losses and nonempty kwargs; adding source auxiliary or SSL terms requires a separately named pre-registered identity and budget.
retained: ordered Conv1d6->64 task adapter, no arbitrary-axis averaging
MASF four learned spectral filters40/48/56/64, temporal rFFT/irFFT n=T, nearest interpolation to actual FFT bins
source CustomProcessing pooled64-time/V=1 dynamic logits with Linear1->4, Linear64->4 and Linear16->4; softmax across4 filters
static logits4x1x64x1x1, dynamic/static weighted sums averaged, then source residual mean
ten temporal encoder blocks with dilations2^i, Conv/ReLU, non-running InstanceNorm, sigmoid-positive linear attention with source epsilon inside key-sum vector, Conv/dropout/residual
FACM temporal FFT, concatenate real+imag along BATCH, two shared biased pointwise convs, split/irFFT n=T/residual
omitted: skeleton MultiScale_GraphConv/SP stem, joint graph and body-joint claims
spatial SFI fusion and its branches; singleton V=1 is a latent feature location only
action-text/BERT, action segmentation/refinement/boundary heads and ASRF
action smoothing/AADL/boundary/classification losses and temporal action labels
source FACM's allocated-but-unused BN/ReLU modules; no ghost parameters
paper_code_differences: Port is only the spectral and temporal architectural core, not the complete skeleton-STAS pipeline or its losses.
Removing graph/SFI and projecting genuine IMU channels into64 latent features is the explicit task adaptation, not a source skeleton reproduction.
Source linear attention method is named elu but actually applies sigmoid; port follows the executable code.
FACM source executes neither its allocated BatchNorm nor ReLU; port retains executed real/imag algebra only.
Reduced diagnostic channel counts generalize only the hardcoded static-logit64 feature axis and are not the admitted source-width profile.
Source masks become all-valid admitted T200 features, not action/boundary or hidden pose supervision.
adaptation.dependency_scope: Standard torch FFT/nn only; no graph/text acquisition pipeline, NumPy/einops/timm imports or external parameters.
runtime_risks: MASF starts with identical all-ones filters; dynamic/static selector gradients may initially be zero until filter weights diverge. Future tests deliberately perturb filters before selector-gradient assertions.
FFT precision/device support and all-source-depth full B128/stride200 capacity unmeasured.
